'''Barleos Choid''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|human]] officer of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] at the time of the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Dread War]], he was stationed on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Oricon]]'s surface as a supply officer specializing in captured goods for the [[Dread Executioners]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Barleos Choid was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 2.4: The Dread War. He serves as the Reputation Vendor for the Dread Executioners, the Imperial version of the reputation group on Oricon.<ref name="TOR" />
